skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and classify social systems, organizations, management, managers.
Analyze management environment, ethics, social responsibility, globalization characteristics and impact on organizational management.
Understand decision making process, planning, organizing, leading, controlling functions.
Practice effective communication, presentation, negotiation, teamwork, group management, time management.
Practice problem-solving decision-making skills for real-life issues.
Practice planning, organizing, leading, and controlling skills for specific systems/organizations/groups.
Demonstrate independent work capability, professional responsibility, service spirit, social responsibility, ethical conduct, self-study ability, and adaptability to changes.
